title: A robust obstruction to full strong pluripotency for wild blender-horseshoes
summary: Suppose that $M$ is a closed manifold of dimension greater than two and $r \ge 2$. We show that there exists a \(C^r\)-diffeomorphism \(f:M\to M\) with a wild affine blender-horseshoe \(Λ_f\) such that \(f\) is \(C^r\)-robustly strongly pluripotent, in the sense that after arbitrarily small perturbations a positive-Lebesgue-measure family of orbits can shadow a prescribed orbit in time average, for the dense subset \(Λ_f^{(\mathrm{mj})}\) consisting of itineraries satisfying the majority condition, namely, those for which the symbol \(0\) occupies at least half of certain growing terminal…
